label: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA — NOT REAL PATIENT DATA
transcript: Doctor: Kay tras hoto ahe? Patient: Mala tin divsapasun taap ani angadukhi ahe, ani pot dukhtay thoda. Doctor: He acidity mule hou shakte. Pantoprazole 40 mg roj sakali ekda, saat divas ghya. Ani Paracetamol 650 mg garaj asel tar din mein don vela ghya. Tikhat khane taalaa.
